indicators.label: Population
indicators.claimNote: Mid-year estimates of everyone living in the country, based on censuses and UN population estimates.
indicators.name: Population, total
originalSources: World Population Prospects, United Nations (UN)
Statistical databases and publications from national statistical offices, National Statistical Offices (NSOs)
Eurostat: Demographic Statistics, Eurostat (ESTAT)
Population and Vital Statistics Report (various years), United Nations (UN)

indicators.label: GDP
indicators.claimNote: National accounts from official statistics and the OECD, converted to US dollars at official exchange rates. The World Bank fills some gaps with its own staff estimates, and recent years may be preliminary.
indicators.name: GDP (current US$)
originalSources: Country official statistics, National Statistical Organizations and/or Central Banks
National Accounts data files, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

indicators.label: GDP per person
indicators.claimNote: GDP divided by mid-year population, in current US dollars. Some values are World Bank staff estimates.
indicators.name: GDP per capita (current US$)
originalSources: Country official statistics, National Statistical Organizations and/or Central Banks
National Accounts data files, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

indicators.label: GDP growth
indicators.claimNote: Annual change in GDP at constant prices (adjusted for inflation). Some values are World Bank staff estimates.
indicators.name: GDP growth (annual %)
originalSources: Country official statistics, National Statistical Organizations and/or Central Banks
National Accounts data files, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

indicators.label: Inflation
indicators.claimNote: Annual change in consumer prices, as reported to the IMF.
indicators.name: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)
originalSources: International Financial Statistics database, International Monetary Fund (IMF)

indicators.label: Unemployment
indicators.claimNote: Modelled estimate by the International Labour Organization (ILO), not a national survey figure.
indicators.name: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
originalSources: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO)

indicators.label: Trade
indicators.claimNote: Exports plus imports of goods and services, as a share of GDP. Some values are World Bank staff estimates.
indicators.name: Trade (% of GDP)
originalSources: Country official statistics, National Statistical Organizations and/or Central Banks
National Accounts data files, Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
Staff estimates, World Bank (WB)

indicators.label: Military spending
indicators.claimNote: Compiled by SIPRI from official and open sources. Some values are SIPRI estimates; the World Bank data does not mark which.
indicators.name: Military expenditure (current USD)
originalSources: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database, Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI)

indicators.label: Military spending
indicators.claimNote: SIPRI military expenditure as a share of GDP. Some values are SIPRI estimates.
indicators.name: Military expenditure (% of GDP)
originalSources: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database, Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI)

indicators.label: Armed forces personnel
indicators.claimNote: Active-duty military and paramilitary personnel, as estimated by the International Institute for Strategic Studies (IISS).
indicators.name: Armed forces personnel, total
originalSources: The Military Balance, International Institute for Strategic Studies
